key_insight: Scalarization connects interval-valued optimization to LU-nondominated solutions and supports a proximal point algorithm with convergence guarantees.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers an approach to interval-valued lasso regression for machine learning with uncertain data.
method: Relate scalarized optima to LU-nondominated solutions.
Apply proximal point iterations with sublinear convergence for convex cases and linear convergence for strongly convex cases.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments, comparison with an existing method, and an interval-valued lasso application, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Check the precise convergence assumptions and cost of solving each proximal subproblem before deployment.
paper_title: Proximal point algorithm for interval valued optimization problems with application to lasso problem
